title: P4 bounded completed-roll goal: scoped selection judgment

judgment.basis: Director permits a narrow optional finite-goal-command comparison: bounded goal steps, near-preserved measured free-cut speed and sword K, exact first living LS attack, all later player requests accepted, no measured directed target error beyond90deg or grip collapse.
judgment.publicDeliveryReceipt: separate integration/common/browser/delivery record; this report is not a deployment receipt
judgment.rawJudgmentPreserved: Original pass means measurement validity. Existing raw effectAccepted:false remains unchanged; this later scoped director decision does not relabel unexposed gates.

mechanism.target: Completed directed legacy flatTarget only; prior target transported by old/new blade axis, then signed roll step bounded. No re-selection of rest/motion normal signs.
mechanism.preserved: Input, torque gains/caps, mass, inertia, native physical pose and solver remain unchanged; altered target can still alter physical force/contact.
mechanism.productionParity: src/roll_target.js uses the same active-path arithmetic as bounded_roll_candidate.mjs; contact pairs call the production helper itself. Production additionally clears history on disabled/bypassed intervals. This is not a claim of byte-identical whole fighter source.

protocol.swordsmanship: ordinary v2 r2 manual in both sides
protocol.candidate: player-only from spawn in contact runs
protocol.approach: 240-step start lock; ordinary forward stick1 until baseline pelvis gap <=2.8m. Both use exact tick420 start and same requested/applied touch input. No pose, health or equipment injection.
protocol.extension: Once only: raise48, hold24, cut30, followHold36 using original deltas; normal forward resumes. No seed/gap/gear search.
protocol.causalLimit: First altered goal/native tick584; enemy input first differs646. Later motion/contact differences describe reactive full-game compatibility, not an isolated force/power or combat-efficacy estimate.
protocol.edgeMetricDefinitions: Free-space recut error is post-step unsigned native .7-blade transverse-speed-weighted plane error. Contact report error is an unweighted mean restricted to transverse speed >0.5m/s. Do not mix these means. Axial travel is integral abs(omega dot current blade axis)dt; it is not a universal lower-is-better measure.

accounting.independence: Executed rows counted as cost, not independent successes. Free-space legacy baselines repeat; extension repeats each own first864 steps exactly. Historical round4 bridge is reuse, not a new run. Earlier rejected candidates excluded and retained in their original reports.

runs.cliLabelNote: The firstCut CLI token in bounded01 is historical; the frozen runner actually selects recut at tick318.

historicalBaselineBridge.limits: Current baseline compared with preserved round4 baseline, not a new independent historical observation. Input hash layout differs; requested tape contract is preserved by source and new pair hashes.

limits: Bounded goal slew does not bound physical roll speed, total travel, torque or contact impulse.
Free-space Q recut physical edge error worsens about4.39deg from spawn; LS about0.73deg. Speed and K remain close, not mathematically invariant.
Living first attack at576..578 precedes actual goal intervention584, so exact impact does not prove post-limiter active-cut power.
Postintervention positive cutting reaction exists in tap phase only; appended active cut produces no positive cutting reaction in either arm. Living blunt contacts still occur.

After enemy-input divergence646, tap axial peak rises33.14→43.94rad/s and release axial travel rises2.594→3.403rad. These are retained warnings, not an isolated causal rejection or proof of general improvement.
Broad Q actual contact and multi-weapon/global roll behavior remain untested here. No automatic claim of complete naturalness or unconditional full-power strike.
